source.image_licence_note: The COCO Consortium does not own the image copyrights. Each image keeps the Flickr licence listed per image (license_id/name/url) and use must follow the Flickr Terms of Use. Images are NOT stored in this repository; they are fetched on demand from coco_url into a local, git-ignored cache.

selection_rule.text: COCO 2017 val images that contain at least one non-crowd instance of {traffic light, stop sign, person} AND at least one non-crowd instance of {car, bus, truck, motorcycle, bicycle}; crowd (iscrowd=1) annotations never qualify an image (crowd-only images are excluded); qualifying image ids sorted ascending, first 300 taken.
selection_rule.crowd_policy: iscrowd=1 annotations do not qualify an image; in scoring they are ignore regions
